result.topic_en: Heavily revised pencil drafts, written on a printed ledger form, of a passage stating that a function of $x+yi$ must have discontinuities at points of $T'$ (prescribed singularities), with conditions under which a function of $x+yi$ can have discontinuities of a given kind, e.g. becoming infinite of the first order.

items.english: that a function of x+yi cannot take on certain discontinuities at all, e.g. discontinuities of the first kind

items.quote:
eine Function von $x+yi$ kann daher immer ... vorgeschriebenen Unstetigkeitsbedingungen gemäss be-
stimmt werden, wenn sie für jeden Punkt ... unendlich werden sollen, die vorge-
schriebene Unstetigkeit die einer gegebenen dort unstetigen Function von $x+yi$ ist.
items.english: A function of x+yi can therefore always be determined according to prescribed discontinuity conditions if, at every point where it is to become infinite, the prescribed discontinuity is that of a given function of x+yi discontinuous there.
